summary: Dependency-confusion canary exfiltrating installer hostname via DNS to attacker-controlled OOB domain
details: The package @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/archetype at version 999.0.1 is a dependency-confusion payload published under a scoped name with an implausibly high version intended to win resolution against an internal package of the same name. On module load, after a 5-second delay, it reads the installer's hostname via `require('os').hostname()` and issues a DNS resolution for `<hostname>.a999.dc.oob.s4yhii.com` using `require('dns').resolve`, encoding the installer's host identifier as a subdomain label sent to an out-of-band DNS collector at `s4yhii.com`. The destination is not associated with the apparent scope `@galicia-toolkit-nestjs` and is a generic OOB callback domain. Installing or requiring the package in a build or runtime environment where it resolves successfully causes the host identifier to be leaked to a third-party collector, confirming internal package-name exposure and the reachability of the host.
